LESSON: PRANAYAM

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Yoga
Topic 5.1: Pranayam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Pranayam. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.
